symbols.name: JobDefinition

Schema preserves decoded/encoded types and both service requirements.
Routing and policy are selected during production, not by this contract.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Lazily declares a frozen contract with version 1 when omitted. Each execution
snapshots the configuration. Invalid declarations and unsupported Schemas fail
with InvalidJobDefinition, without acquiring encoding or decoding services.
Install complete handlers with JobGroup; produce through JobProducer slots.

symbols.name: InvalidJobQueue

symbols.name: JobQueue

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Creates a frozen logical queue. Names are 1–64 ASCII characters matching
^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$; invalid names throw InvalidJobQueue. Creates no storage or worker.

symbols.name: Binding
symbols.description: One consequence's contract, closed routing declaration and resolved policy.

symbols.name: Bindings

symbols.name: Input

symbols.name: InvalidProducerBinding

symbols.name: JobProducer

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Starts an immutable producer declaration. Add consequences with withSlot;

symbols.name: Routing

symbols.name: withSlot
symbols.description:
Adds one immutable binding, preserving prior slot types and Schema services.

symbols.name: DecodingServices

symbols.name: Definitions

symbols.name: Handlers

symbols.name: HandlerServices

symbols.name: HandlersFrom

symbols.name: InstalledHandlers

symbols.name: InvalidJobGroup

symbols.name: JobGroupConfigurationError

symbols.description:
Declares a named group, preserving aliases and payload types. The name is a

symbols.name: addGroup

symbols.name: Group

symbols.name: Groups

symbols.name: HandlerServices

Every declared group's exact installation requirement. Structural TS types

symbols.name: InvalidJobApi

symbols.name: JobApi
symbols.description: A pipeable declaration; there is no acquisition, registry or finalize step.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description: Starts an empty catalog. Workers require at least one runnable definition.

symbols.name: group

Acquires callback dependencies once per Layer acquisition; invocation services

symbols.name: Handlers

symbols.name: CatalogIdentity

symbols.name: InvalidOperationId

symbols.name: JobName

Job-name Schema: 1–128 ASCII characters matching nameFormat.
Stable job-name Schema: 1–128 ASCII characters matching nameFormat.

symbols.name: JobVersion
symbols.description: Explicit catalog version Schema: an integer in 1–32,767.

symbols.name: nameFormat
symbols.description: ASCII declaration-name grammar shared by queue, name, operation and slot Schemas.

symbols.name: OperationId
symbols.description:
Opaque operation-ID Schema: valid Unicode scalars, no NUL, 1–256 UTF-8 bytes.
Application-branded strings are accepted without an extra library brand.

symbols.name: OperationName
symbols.description: Producer operation-name Schema: 1–128 ASCII characters matching nameFormat.

symbols.name: ProducerIdentity
symbols.description: Operation/operationId/slot Schema and literal-preserving deduplication identity.

symbols.name: QueueName
symbols.description: Queue-name Schema: 1–64 ASCII characters matching nameFormat.

symbols.name: SlotName
symbols.description: Consequence-slot Schema: 1–128 ASCII characters matching nameFormat.

symbols.name: validateOperationId
symbols.description:
Lazily validates Unicode scalars, absence of NUL and 1–256 UTF-8 bytes.
Fails with InvalidOperationId without echoing the ID; never normalizes it.

symbols.name: validateProducerDeclaration
symbols.description:
Validates operation and unique slots synchronously; throws
JobDeclarationError. Empty slots are valid during immutable assembly.

symbols.name: JobId
symbols.description:
Decoded value of the JobId Schema.
Nonempty branded identifier generated by persistence on first insertion.
Applications never supply job IDs to enqueue.

symbols.name: EncodedJobPayload
symbols.description:
Validated canonical payload and semantic bytes. Codec executions own their buffers;
receivers copy before retention because readonly does not freeze Uint8Array contents.

symbols.name: EnqueueInput
symbols.description:
Decoded payload, stable producer identity and resolved policy. No caller job ID.
Matching duplicates retain the original queue, policy and availability.

symbols.name: EnqueueResult
symbols.description:
Inserted or AlreadyPresent with the durable job ID. Success inside a joined
transaction is provisional until the application owner commits.
Tagged constructors and matchers for enqueue results.

symbols.name: HandlerContext
symbols.description:
Handler metadata without SQL, lease tokens or finalization authority.
nextFinalizationNumber is one-based and may repeat after unknown outcomes and recovery.

symbols.name: HandlerInput
symbols.description: Decoded Schema payload plus library metadata; handler dependencies use Effect services.

symbols.name: InvalidJobInput
symbols.description: Typed enqueue validation failure exposing only the invalid field.

symbols.name: JobIntegrityConflict
symbols.description:
Same producer tuple with different kind/version or semantic payload. Propagate the
failure to the transaction owner; do not commit partial domain writes.

symbols.name: JobPayloadCodecError
symbols.description: Bounded codec failure reason without raw payload or Schema diagnostic inputs.

symbols.name: JobPayloadDecoder
symbols.description: Codec signature preserving Schema decoding services in the Effect environment.

symbols.name: JobPayloadEncoder
symbols.description: Codec signature preserving Schema encoding services in the Effect environment.

symbols.name: jobPayloadFormatVersion
symbols.description: Current canonical encoded payload/projection format discriminator.

symbols.name: JobPolicyIncompatible
symbols.description:
New production cannot reserve its attempt timeout and this storage's response budget.
Matching duplicates still retain their original policy. No payload data is exposed.

symbols.name: maximumJobPayloadBytes
symbols.description: Maximum canonical payload size in bytes (64 KiB).

symbols.name: maximumJobPayloadDepth
symbols.description: Maximum payload nesting depth (32).

symbols.name: maximumJobPayloadSchemaPathBytes
symbols.description: Maximum protected Schema path size in UTF-8 bytes (256).

symbols.name: maximumJobSemanticProjectionBytes
symbols.description: Maximum canonical semantic-projection size in bytes (64 KiB).

symbols.name: maximumProtectedJobPayloadSubtrees
symbols.description: Maximum marked protected subtrees per payload (16).

symbols.name: PreparedJob
symbols.description: Prepared production artifact and first configuration; persistence assigns the ID.

symbols.name: JobEnqueue
symbols.description: Configured application storage; provided by a qualified persistence Layer.

symbols.name: JobEnqueueService
symbols.description:
The configured producer owns presence checks and the transaction; preparation preserves E/R.
enqueue joins only an active configured transaction. Standalone owns the entire
prepare/insert/commit operation and returns after commit acknowledgement.

symbols.name: JobPersistenceError
symbols.description:
Safe persistence failure preserving commit knowledge and transaction misuse.
No SQL, credentials, provider Causes or payloads are retained.

symbols.name: JobEnqueueError
symbols.description: Core enqueue failures; storage errors remain in the caller's separate E channel.

symbols.name: JobsTransaction
symbols.description:
Transaction callback capability; never fabricate or retain it outside the callback.
E and R preserve storage errors and requirements. No public constructor, SQL,
commit, rollback or replay authority; sequence operations on the same transaction.

symbols.name: JobsTransactionClosed
symbols.description: Typed failure when enqueue runs after its transaction callback has exited.

symbols.name: JobTransactionsService
symbols.description:
Qualified application manager port, delegating join-or-establish without a
second transaction engine. The outer application owner controls commit and replay.

symbols.name: encrypted
symbols.description:
Bind a decoded domain Schema to an app-owned encrypted JSON envelope.
Domain encoding/validation precedes seal; open precedes domain decoding/validation.
Multiple independent fields, structs, arrays, optionals and unions are supported.
Setup is lazy and fails with InvalidEncryptedSchema in the Effect error channel.
Each execution snapshots schema, envelope and codec methods into a fresh Schema.
Encrypted-within-encrypted and recursive domain schemas fail during setup.
All encrypted fields are opened before the handler; this is not selective access.
Malformed envelopes/domain data follow the existing bounded artifact decode path.
Defects and interruption are not converted to codec failures. No remote key retry
contract is added; configured keys must be validated before worker startup.

symbols.name: EncryptionCodec
symbols.description:
Application codec over the domain's encoded representation. The envelope must
be an identity JSON schema with an own fingerprint field. Seal/open resolve
application services lazily; keys are validated by application Layers at startup.
Fingerprints must use stable keyed semantics independent of encryption randomness.
No cryptographic implementation or authenticated context binding is supplied.

symbols.name: InvalidEncryptedSchema
symbols.description: Actionable unsupported schema configuration, without domain values.

symbols.name: JobEncryptionError
symbols.description: Bounded codec failure. Provider details, plaintext and keys must stay private.

symbols.name: protected
symbols.description:
Marks an application-owned, already-protected JSON representation. Requires an
own fingerprint in the encoded value. This neither proves protection nor seals
or opens data. Encryption and stable fingerprint keys remain application-owned.
The schema may describe any JSON fingerprint; no envelope shape or crypto key
manager is imposed. Unsupported protected mappings fail when the codec runs.

symbols.name: decodeJobPayload
symbols.description:
Validates canonical format, bounds, Schema and semantic projection before
domain decoding. Requires the Schema's decoding services; fails with
JobPayloadCodecError. Consistent projection bytes are not authenticity.

symbols.name: encodeJobPayload
symbols.description:
Encodes the validated wire representation, not the decoded domain object.
Structs, arrays, absent optional keys and unions are supported. Domain
transforms must have a JSON encoded side; transforms across protected markers,
recursive/custom shapes, records and tuples fail with invalid-schema.
Each returned buffer is owned independently by this execution. Receivers must
copy buffers before retaining them; readonly properties do not freeze bytes.
Requires the Schema's encoding services; failures are JobPayloadCodecError.
Finite fractional numbers are supported; NaN and infinities are rejected.

symbols.name: defaultPolicy
symbols.description:
Deeply immutable shared policy with the same defaults as make().
Caller-owned options are never frozen or mutated.

symbols.name: EpochMillis
symbols.description:
Positive bounded epoch-millisecond Schema. Epoch zero is rejected; past positive
timestamps are valid and availability is not an execution deadline.

symbols.name: FixedDelayV1
symbols.description: Versioned persisted fixed-delay retry schedule; no exponential backoff.

symbols.name: JobPolicy
symbols.description:
Complete immutable policy resolved by make; the attempt limit counts finalizations.
Validates resolved in-memory policy without decoding its storage representation.
Requires attemptTimeoutMillis < leaseDurationMillis.

symbols.name: JobPolicyConfigurationError
symbols.description: Expected validation failure in make's typed error channel; supplied values are not echoed.

symbols.name: JobPolicyConfigurationField
symbols.description: Exact option path reported for invalid public configuration.

symbols.name: JobPolicyOptions
symbols.description:
Optional Duration-based configuration. Finite durations must be positive integer
milliseconds; only retention accepts Duration.infinity.

symbols.name: JobRetention
symbols.description:
Decoded value of the JobRetention Schema.
Persisted Forever or finite Duration retention, measured from terminal completion.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Lazily validates and freezes complete policy; expected errors stay in the Effect channel.
Defaults: 90s fixed lease, 30s attempt timeout, 5s retry delay, 3 finalized attempts,
1 stalled recovery, 90d Completed retention and Forever Dead retention.
Timeout must be strictly shorter than the lease. Unknown outcomes can repeat a
finalization ordinal; maxFinalizedAttempts does not bound every handler invocation.

symbols.name: maximumMillis
symbols.description: Upper bound for persisted durations and positive epoch-millisecond timestamps.

symbols.name: PersistedJobPolicy
symbols.description:
Storage codec: retained JSON maxAttempts maps to public maxFinalizedAttempts.
Encode with this codec before persistence, never JSON.stringify a resolved policy.
Decoding stored policy never applies current deployment defaults or changes limits.

symbols.name: PositiveMillis
symbols.description: Integer milliseconds in 1–253,402,300,799,999; no rounding or clamping.

symbols.name: capped
symbols.description: Cap the base delay before jitter, regardless of combinator order.

symbols.name: exponential
symbols.description: Exponential delay, factor 2 by default; first retry uses the supplied base.

symbols.name: fixed
symbols.description: Fixed delay; defaults to at most three finalized attempts.

symbols.name: jittered
symbols.description: Integer jitter in 80–120% of nominal delay, with the range bounded by the hard cap.

symbols.name: JobRetryPolicy
symbols.description: A reusable unvalidated description; Policy.make supplies the typed validation boundary.

symbols.name: maxFinalizedAttempts
symbols.description: Maximum finalized attempts including the first, 1–100; 1 disables retries.

symbols.name: FailureCode
symbols.description:
1–128 ASCII identifier characters. Catalog membership is not a storage requirement.
Codes must never contain provider messages, secrets or private identifiers.
Validation checks syntax, not whether a valid identifier contains sensitive data.

symbols.name: InvalidJobFailure
symbols.description: Thrown synchronously by JobFailures for an invalid retry cutoff.

symbols.name: JobFailure
symbols.description:
Decoded value of the JobFailure Schema.
Explicit Retry, Dead, Isolate or OutcomeUnknown handler failure Schema/type.
Unknown does not prove the external effect failed and is not a durable state.

symbols.name: JobFailures
symbols.description:
Frozen outcome factories taking validated codes; invalid retry cutoffs throw InvalidJobFailure.
Map domain errors with ordinary Effect composition before installing handlers.

symbols.name: define
symbols.description:
Validate a catalog once, preserving each literal and adding the brand.
Throws InvalidFailureCode at definition time. Define catalogs before startup.

symbols.name: FailureCode
symbols.description:
1–128 ASCII identifier characters. Catalog membership is not a storage requirement.
Codes must never contain provider messages, secrets or private identifiers.
Validation checks syntax, not whether a valid identifier contains sensitive data.

symbols.name: InvalidFailureCode
symbols.description: Safe entry-specific configuration diagnostic, without retaining the value.

symbols.name: parse
symbols.description: Parse a dynamic or historical identifier without throwing or requiring a catalog.

symbols.name: JobStorage
symbols.description: Application-selected storage, independent of SQL peers and handler groups.

symbols.name: JobStorageConfigurationError
symbols.description: Invalid storage configuration; no provider or payload values are retained.

symbols.name: JobStorageService
symbols.description: Captured execution port and its one positive finite response reserve.

symbols.name: JobStorageUnavailable
symbols.description: Safe infrastructure failure. Does not prove that a dispatched write rolled back.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.description: Provides captured storage; source requirements remain visible on the Layer.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Captures provider requirements once and snapshots the budget. Typed provider
failures cross a safe infrastructure boundary; library protocol/admission errors,
defects, interruptions and explicit Unknown results retain their semantics.
Own the source's lifetime outside this service; no borrowing, readiness, DDL,
polling, cleanup or pool shutdown occurs here. This is not an atomicity proof.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description: Adapter input. The qualified store must use this same budget for admission.

symbols.name: drain
symbols.description:
Runs bounded recovery and claims with concurrency fixed at worker construction.
Idle observes an empty claim; MoreWork reaches the run limit; Backoff requests
delayed retry after storage uncertainty. None promises exactly-once effects.

symbols.name: DrainLimits
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: DrainResult
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: JobWorker
symbols.description: Application-composed worker service; construction starts no execution.

symbols.name: JobWorkerConfigurationError
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: JobWorkerNotReady
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: JobWorkerService
symbols.description: Sealed execution capability captured by bounded drain and scoped polling.

symbols.name: JobWorkerUnavailable
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.description: Construction is inert; drain and polling have explicit application-owned lifetimes.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description: Captures a complete handler group and configures queue concurrency before use.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: QueueOptions
symbols.description: Public integration contract; see the exported declaration.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.description:
Starts one scoped loop per queue when the Layer is built, requiring JobWorker.
Validates all queues before forking. Scope closure first interrupts admission
loops, including permit waits, recovery and in-flight claims. Already-started
executions retain their scopes and can finalize during one shared grace period.
After grace expiry remaining executions are interrupted, never released as safe
unexecuted work. Unknown effects remain subject to lease recovery.
Source acquisition/control/release and handler finalizers must be finitely bounded
and interruption-cooperative; a grace timer cannot hard-kill arbitrary native or
uninterruptible user code. One-shot drain interruption remains immediate.
Build only in the application-owned lifetime; importing or constructing starts no work.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description:
Polling configuration; idlePollMillis defaults to 1,000 positive integer
milliseconds. Idle/backoff sleeps include jitter. shutdownGraceMillis defaults
to 30,000; integer 0–300,000, with zero requesting immediate interruption.

symbols.name: JobSchedule
symbols.description: Application-selected observation source, provided separately from execution storage.

symbols.name: JobScheduleProtocolError
symbols.description: Invalid observation request or malformed storage metadata; never includes row values.

symbols.name: JobScheduleService
symbols.description: Captured safe observation service; independent of handler installation and workers.

symbols.name: JobScheduleUnavailable
symbols.description: Safe source failure; no provider diagnostics or database parameters are retained.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.description: Provide an explicit observation source. No polling, alarms or migrations are installed.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description: Capture source requirements without performing reads or owning its resource lifetime.

symbols.name: Observation
symbols.description:
The earliest supported availability in a bounded queue head and earliest active lease.
Null availability with saturated=true is inconclusive, not an empty queue.
Subtract observedAt from timestamps for delays; never treat process time as DB time.
Runtime observation contract. Past timestamps are due; no lifecycle state is changed.

symbols.name: observe
symbols.description:
Observe the selected group's contracts in one queue, without requiring handlers.
Recovery is queue-scoped, including expired leases for other contracts, just like drain.
Hints can become stale immediately after reading. Keep a finite repair wakeup even
when timestamps are null; saturated samples especially cannot establish emptiness.
The application owns authorization, activation expiry and exclusive alarm ownership.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description: Per-observation metadata sample size; defaults to 100, maximum 500.

symbols.name: Reader
symbols.description:
Qualified read-only source. Validate requests before queries, snapshot their selection,
return only bounded metadata from one authoritative-clock observation, and never lock,
claim, recover or modify jobs. Source acquisition/query/release must be finitely bounded.
Saturation reports an incomplete pending/retry sample, not an exact queue count.

symbols.name: Request
symbols.description: One queue and at most 500 supported contracts; limit is an integer in 1–500.

symbols.name: addTimestamp
symbols.description:
Adds positive bounded milliseconds without overflow/clamping. Adapters supply
one DB-time snapshot for the entire atomic transition; reads no process clock.

symbols.name: BatchLimit
symbols.description: Bounded storage recovery/cleanup batch Schema: integer 1–500.

symbols.name: cancel
symbols.description: Cancels only unowned executable rows. Cancelled retention is Forever.

symbols.name: claim
symbols.description:
Plans a due Pending/RetryScheduled claim (availableAt <= dbNow) with a fixed lease.
Does not increment attempts; storage must lock/CAS and commit atomically.

symbols.name: cleanupEligible
symbols.description:
Pure terminal-retention eligibility at expiry <= dbNow. Pending, Active,
RetryScheduled, Isolated and Cancelled are excluded. Application/persistence must coordinate
domain references and deletion atomically; this result is not deletion authority.

symbols.name: Counter
symbols.description: Nonnegative safe integer Schema for durable counters, not a policy limit.

symbols.name: finalizationFromFailure
symbols.description:
Maps only validated explicit failure values; OutcomeUnknown returns null, leaving
no confirmed transition. Cause/defect/interruption classification belongs to the worker.

symbols.name: finalize
symbols.description:
Plans one fenced Complete/Retry/Dead/Isolate transition and increments attempts once.
Uses the first stored retry policy; next availability >= retryBefore or exhausted attempts
becomes Dead. retryBefore limits retry scheduling, not handler execution.

symbols.name: isOwned
symbols.description:
Checks exact Active job/token/version/expiry and leaseExpiresAt > dbNow.
A lease at the expiry millisecond is no longer owned.

symbols.name: JobFinalization
symbols.description:
Confirmable durable transitions; OutcomeUnknown is deliberately absent.
Retry uses the first stored policy; callers cannot replace its schedule.

symbols.name: JobFinalizations
symbols.description: Tagged constructors and matchers for durable finalization commands.

symbols.name: JobLifecycleError
symbols.description: Bounded validation, arithmetic, eligibility or ownership failure for a pure plan.

symbols.name: JobOwnership
symbols.description:
Decoded value of the JobOwnership Schema.
Exact job/token/expiry/version fencing identity; handlers do not receive it.

symbols.name: JobSnapshot
symbols.description:
Decoded complete lifecycle metadata; does not include or validate the payload.
Complete durable metadata. Payload validation belongs to the codec, not this Schema.

symbols.name: JobState
symbols.description: Durable states; OutcomeUnknown is an attempt outcome rather than a state.

symbols.name: LeaseToken
symbols.description: Bounded lease token Schema: 1–128 hexadecimal/hyphen characters.

symbols.name: nextFinalizationNumber
symbols.description:
One-based finalizedAttempts + 1; may repeat after unknown outcomes and recovery.
Not an invocation count or external idempotency key.

symbols.name: ownershipOf
symbols.description: Extracts fencing identity from an Active snapshot; otherwise returns ownership-lost.

symbols.name: recoverExpired
symbols.description:
Plans recovery at leaseExpiresAt <= dbNow. Increments stalls, not attempts;
exceeding maxStalledCount makes the job Dead. Persistence owns bounded atomic recovery.

symbols.name: release
symbols.description:
Plans release only before execution and while the exact lease remains owned.
Clears ownership without incrementing attempts; storage commits the plan atomically.

symbols.name: retryNow
symbols.description: Strictly accelerates a future stored retry without changing any budget or policy.

symbols.name: usableLease
symbols.description: Checks remaining lease >= attempt timeout + positive operation response budget.

symbols.name: validateSnapshot
symbols.description:
Validates complete lifecycle metadata and cross-field invariants, returning
Result rather than raw Schema diagnostics; does not validate payload artifacts.

symbols.name: ClaimedJob
symbols.description: Fenced claim plus untrusted prepared artifact; validate fully before handler dispatch.

symbols.name: ClaimReconciliation
symbols.description:
Read-only original-token result: usable Owned, InsufficientLease, NotOwned or Unknown.
Tagged constructors and matchers for claim reconciliation.

symbols.name: ClaimRequest
symbols.description: One supported queue/catalog selection with a fresh caller token for reconciliation.

symbols.name: ClaimResult
symbols.description:
Claimed, observed Empty or uncertain Unknown; reconcile Unknown by its original
caller token before further dispatch.
Tagged constructors and matchers for claim results.

symbols.name: FinalizationReconciliation
symbols.description:
Read-only exact-transition result; StillOwned permits only bounded identical
finalization retry, never immediate handler replay.
Tagged constructors and matchers for finalization reconciliation.

symbols.name: FinalizationRequest
symbols.description: Exact ownership, frozen pre-write snapshot and requested durable transition.

symbols.name: FinalizationResult
symbols.description:
Applied or Unknown write result; response loss does not prove rollback.
Tagged constructors and matchers for finalization results.

symbols.name: JobCleanupService
symbols.description: Separate replaceable app-owned port; the store must not bypass domain references.

symbols.name: JobOwnershipLost
symbols.description: Typed rejection of a stale or expired ownership capability.

symbols.name: JobStoreProtocolError
symbols.description: Bounded malformed input/artifact failure, without persisted payload diagnostics.

symbols.name: JobStoreService
symbols.description:
Explicit configured port, not a persistence constructor or atomicity proof.
E/R preserve provider failure and connection requirements. Unknown dispatched writes
MUST be returned as Unknown (including response loss); typed failures cannot imply rollback.
Never replay mutations automatically. Lock/CAS the exact state/token/version using one
DB-time snapshot, fixed non-renewable leases and bounded validated arithmetic.
Claim atomically selects at most one due supported row and its immutable payload;
its lease must reserve stored timeout plus configured positive operation-response budget.
Reconciliation reads once by the ORIGINAL caller token, never by an unrelated new claim.
All transitions preserve first policy, identities and artifact bytes; no lease renewal.

symbols.name: validateClaimRequest
symbols.description:
Validates queue, nonempty same-queue catalogs and token before dispatching mutation.
Returns Result with sanitized JobStoreProtocolError on malformed input.

symbols.name: JobCorrectedRedriveRequest
symbols.description: Full replacement in the definition's decoded payload type.

symbols.name: JobLineage
symbols.description: Live reference may disappear without erasing original identity.

symbols.name: JobOperatorExpected
symbols.description: Exact source state/version guard.

symbols.name: JobOperatorRejected
symbols.description: Bounded rejection; no SQL, payload or provider diagnostics.

symbols.name: JobOperators
symbols.description: Trusted application composition, not caller authentication.

symbols.name: JobOperatorsService
symbols.description: All successes are provisional until the outer owner commits.

symbols.name: JobOperatorTransition
symbols.description: Provisional transition evidence; commit belongs to the application.

symbols.name: JobRedriveKind
symbols.description: Immediate repair edge; original identity survives source retention.

symbols.name: JobRedriveRequest
symbols.description: New producer identity, never the original tuple.

symbols.name: JobRedriveResult
symbols.description: Source remains unchanged; timestamp is sampled after validation.

symbols.name: layerNoDeps
symbols.description:
Produces PostgreSqlJobs while requiring PostgreSqlApplication. Supply a qualified
application adapter separately; neither the driver nor a transaction engine is bundled.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Captures PostgreSqlApplication and validates mapping/budget. Fails with
PostgreSqlConfigurationError; performs no borrowing, readiness SQL, DDL,
worker startup or pool shutdown. Invoke jobs.ready explicitly before use.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description: Storage mapping and its single positive operation response budget.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlJobs
symbols.description: Context service produced by make or layerNoDeps; construction starts no SQL.

symbols.name: Service
symbols.description:
Configured persistence and callback bridge. Readiness, workers and cleanup are
explicit; migrations and pool lifetime remain application-owned.

symbols.name: ApplicationAdapter
symbols.description:
Explicit trusted extension contract, NOT a structural SQL-client constructor.
validate must prove private registration, source identity and active invocation.
withTransaction delegates join-or-establish to the application's manager.
ownedTransaction must reject ambient transactions, commit before returning, and
report uncertain COMMIT/response delivery as Unknown. No automatic replay.
A COMMIT command tag of ROLLBACK is a NotCommitted failure, not success.
All acquisition/query/control/release paths must have finite application bounds.
The application owns rollback, pool lifetime, readiness and migrations.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlApplication
symbols.description: Context service supplied by the application; no universal pg/Drizzle adapter ships.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlError
symbols.description: Sanitized persistence failure or rejected transaction handle.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlFailure
symbols.description:
Sanitized adapter failure. Unknown commit knowledge must stay unknown; never
attach SQL, parameters, DSNs or provider Causes, or infer rollback from timeout.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlInvalidHandle
symbols.description: Typed rejection of foreign, unqualified, inactive or ambient transaction handles.

symbols.name: TransactionQuery
symbols.description:
Exact-connection query capability supplied only by the owning qualified adapter.
Sequence queries and revalidate invocation lifetime before each query.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.description: Supply the application-owned native client explicitly; starts no work.

symbols.name: make
symbols.description:
Construct an adapter without borrowing connections or reading keys/env.
Ambient enqueue resolves this client's transactionService, with no fallback.
The transaction owner must sequence operations and await them in its callback;
retaining/forking transaction contexts outside that callback is unsupported.
Standalone rejects active same-client transactions and returns after native
checked COMMIT. Provider control failures retain Unknown; no automatic replay.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description:
Only native PgClient@4.1.0 is qualified. Pass the exact application-owned client
used by Effect-native Drizzle@1.0.0-rc.5. Other SQL drivers/clients require
separate qualification; structural type compatibility is not a driver guarantee.

symbols.name: creationTimeMigration
symbols.description:
Adds truthful creation metadata without inventing times for existing rows.
Applications run this once in their own migration transaction. Runtime never
migrates; readiness requires this nullable bigint column before use.

symbols.name: indexPrefix
symbols.description: Bounded schema-wide index prefix retaining a hash of the jobs table name.

symbols.name: lineageMigration
symbols.description:
Add empty lineage to existing rows; never infer historical operator edges.
Applications run this once in their own migration transaction.

symbols.name: migration
symbols.description:
Returns DDL for the configured jobs and immutable payload tables and indexes.
The application creates the schema and runs migrations; runtime never invokes DDL.
Use the same mapping for jobs construction.

symbols.name: operatorMigration
symbols.description:
Adds Cancelled to exactly the two known legacy CHECKs; refuses unexpected schema.
Does not alter rows, indexes or unrelated constraints. The application runs it
in its migration transaction after preserving historical migration bytes.

symbols.name: PostgreSqlConfigurationError
symbols.description: Thrown for invalid table configuration or returned for invalid storage budget.

symbols.name: relations
symbols.description:
Returns quoted qualified relation names after validating the mapping.
Never interpolate producer or catalog values as identifiers.

symbols.name: TableOptions
symbols.description: Optional lowercase PostgreSQL identifiers; defaults to public.jobs/job_payloads.

symbols.name: tables
symbols.description:
Validates and freezes mapping without database access. Names match
^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$ and tables must differ; throws PostgreSqlConfigurationError.

symbols.name: Tables
symbols.description: Complete storage mapping shared by runtime configuration and application migration generation.

symbols.name: JobsIndexColumns
symbols.description: Actual typed required jobs columns supplied to the extraIndexes callback.

symbols.name: makeJobTables
symbols.description:
Creates fixed-column Drizzle declarations for the configured namespace/table names.
Requires optional drizzle-orm@1.0.0-rc.5. Applications generate/run migrations;
these declarations neither open a connection nor qualify a transaction adapter.
Dependency qualification scope is documented in specs/drizzle-compatibility.md.

symbols.name: Options
symbols.description:
Drizzle-only additive jobs indexes. The application owns unique schema-wide
names and migration generation. Runtime readiness and baseline SQL are unchanged.
